newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala June consumer prices rise 0.05 percent.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala June consumer prices rise 0.05 percent.

text.p: Guatemalan consumer prices rose 0.05 percent in June, compared to a rise of 0.64 percent in the same month last year, the National Statistics Institute said on Tuesday.
May prices rose 0.16 percent this year.
Accumulated inflation was 3.61 percent at the end of June, compared with 5.42 percent a year ago, the institute said.

Year-over-year inflation was 8.97 percent on June 30, down from 9.61 percent as of May 31. Year-over-year inflation at the end of June 1996 was 10.34 percent. (( -- Lorraine Orlandi, Guatemala City bureau +502 251-5718))
